# 🐝 eBeeControl — Autonomous Deception Engine
### Gemini-powered honeytoken deployment, threat detection, and autonomous response for Kubernetes

2.title: 🍯 Total Honeytokens Deployed
2.query:
fetch logs
| filter contains(content, "honeytokenId") and contains(content, "deploymentTimestamp") and not contains(content, "incidentId")
| summarize count()

3.title: Honeytokens by Type
3.query:
fetch logs
| filter contains(content, "honeytokenId") and contains(content, "deploymentTimestamp") and not contains(content, "incidentId")
| parse content, "JSON:p"
| summarize count=count(), by:{p[type]}

4.title: Honeytokens by Namespace
4.query:
fetch logs
| filter contains(content, "honeytokenId") and contains(content, "deploymentTimestamp") and not contains(content, "incidentId")
| parse content, "JSON:p"
| summarize count=count(), by:{p[namespace]}

6.title: 🚨 Total Attacks Detected
6.query:
fetch logs
| filter contains(content, "accessType") and contains(content, "threatClassification") and not contains(content, "incidentId") and not contains(content, "actionId")
| summarize count()

7.title: Threat Level Breakdown
7.query:
fetch logs
| filter contains(content, "accessType") and contains(content, "threatClassification") and not contains(content, "incidentId") and not contains(content, "actionId")
| parse content, "JSON:p"
| summarize count=count(), by:{p[threatClassification]}

8.title: Attack Timeline
8.query:
fetch logs
| filter contains(content, "accessType") and contains(content, "threatClassification") and not contains(content, "incidentId") and not contains(content, "actionId")
| makeTimeseries count=count(), interval:1m

10.title: ✅ Response Actions Taken
10.query:
fetch logs
| filter contains(content, "actionId") and contains(content, "actionType") and contains(content, "outcome")
| summarize count()

11.title: Actions by Type
11.query:
fetch logs
| filter contains(content, "actionId") and contains(content, "actionType") and contains(content, "outcome")
| parse content, "JSON:p"
| summarize count=count(), by:{p[actionType]}

12.title: Containment Outcomes
12.query:
fetch logs
| filter contains(content, "incidentId") and contains(content, "finalOutcome")
| parse content, "JSON:p"
| summarize count=count(), by:{p[finalOutcome]}

14.title: 🎯 Model Accuracy
14.query:
fetch logs
| filter contains(content, "modelVersionId") and contains(content, "validationAccuracy")
| parse content, "JSON:p"
| sort timestamp desc
| limit 1
| fields p[validationAccuracy]

15.title: 📊 Training Dataset
15.query:
fetch logs
| filter contains(content, "modelVersionId") and contains(content, "trainingDatasetSize")
| parse content, "JSON:p"
| sort timestamp desc
| limit 1
| fields p[trainingDatasetSize]

16.title: 🏥 System Health
16.query:
fetch logs
| filter contains(content, "componentName") and contains(content, "lastSuccessfulCheckTimestamp")
| parse content, "JSON:p"
| sort timestamp desc
| limit 4
| fields p[componentName], p[status]

18.title: Recent Incidents
18.query:
fetch logs
| filter contains(content, "incidentId") and contains(content, "finalOutcome")
| parse content, "JSON:p"
| fields timestamp, p[threatClassification], p[affectedPodId], p[namespace], p[finalOutcome]
| sort timestamp desc
| limit 20

19.title: 🤖 Gemini AI Forensic Reports
19.query:
fetch logs
| filter contains(content, "gistUrl")
| parse content, "JSON:p"
| sort timestamp desc
| limit 3
| fields timestamp, p[reportId], p[gistUrl]
